rules.statement: When an action for partition of a land is dismissed on the ground that the plaintiff has no title to the land, the Court has no jurisdiction to proceed to allot shares among the defendants if the defendants do not agree to ask for partition.
rules.supporting_quote: When an action for partition of a land is dismissed on the ground that the plaintiff has no title to the land, the Court has no jurisdiction to proceed to allot shares among the defendants if the defendants do not agree to ask for partition.
